User Story 2 (25664)– Upload Documents

As an Architect, I want to upload all required documents so that my application meets compliance standards.
column4:
1: System must validate document formats and sizes.
2: All mandatory documents must be uploaded.
3: Missing documents must be highlighted.
4: Final submission must be blocked until all documents are valid.
column9: Open Bugs needs to be fixed

column2:
User Story 3 (25665) – View/Re-Submit Reverted Application

As an Architect, I want to update my application based on feedback so that I can resubmit it for approval.
column4:
1: Reverted applications must display all remarks from the Chief Architect.
2: Architect must be able to edit relevant fields.
3: Resubmitted application must again be routed for approval.
4: Status must display “Resubmitted.”
column9: after submit appn details not freezing & on revert update button not appearing.

column2:
User Story 4 (25666) – Change Architect Type

As an Architect, I want the ability to change my category (Individual / Firm) before final submission.
column4:
1: System must allow category change only before submission.
2: Changing category must refresh the application form fields.
3: All previously filled fields must be reset after type change.
4: System must display a confirmation message before resetting.

column2:
User Story 1 (25667) – Review Application

As a Chief Architect, I want to review architect applications so that I can validate their eligibility.
column4:
1: System must display full application details.
2: System must show uploaded documents.
3: System must allow zoom/view/download of documents.
4: Application cannot be approved if any document is missing.

column2:
User Story 2 (25668) – Approve Application

As a Chief Architect, I want to approve valid applications so the architect can proceed to payment.
column4:
1: Approval must immediately update application status.
2: Payment option must be activated in the architect’s login.
3: Action must be recorded in logs with timestamp.
column9: Payment module yet to be developed.

column2:
User Story 3 (25669) – Revert Application

As a Chief Architect, I want to revert applications with remarks so that architects can correct issues.
column4:
1: Remarks are mandatory for revert.
2: Application must be routed back to architect’s login.
3: Status must display “Reverted with Remarks.”

column2:
User Story 4 (25670) – Activity Logs/History Trail
As a Chief Architect, I want to view the activity logs of the application so I can track progress.
column4:
1: Logs must display activity name, date, time, and status.
2: Logs must include actions taken by both Architect and Chief Architect.
3: Logs must be read-only.

column2:
User Story 1 (25671) – Select Payment Years (for First Payment)

As an architect, I want to select the number of years for annual fees so that I can pay based on certificate validity.
column4:
1: System must show only valid years based on certificate validity.
2: Selection cannot exceed maximum allowed years.
3: Registration fee must be auto-selected.
4: Total amount updates automatically based on selected years.

column2:
User Story 2 (25672) – Select Payment Years (After done first payment)

As an architect, I want to select the number of years for annual fees so that I can pay based on certificate validity.
column4:
1: System must show only valid years based on certificate validity.
2: Selection cannot exceed maximum allowed years.
3: Total amount updates automatically based on selected years.

column2:
User Story 3 (25673) – Make Online Payment

As an architect, I want to pay my fees through multiple online payment modes so that I can complete the payment conveniently.
column4:
1: System must redirect to Unipay on clicking Pay Now.
2: Payment modes must include UPI, Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking.
3: System must display success or failure messages based on payment results.
4: Receipt must generate after successful payment.
5: After that system generated the Empanelment Id

column2:
User Story 4 (25674)– View Payment Summary

As an architect, I want to view a clear payment summary so that I can verify all details before paying.
column4:
1: Summary must show registration fees, annual fees, total years, and total payable amount.
2: Pay Now button must be visible only when details are added.
3: Summary must update whenever the architect changes selected years.

column2:
User Story 5(25675) – View Payment Records

As an architect, I want to view all my past payment history so that I can track my financial transactions.
column4:
1: Payment Details tab must display receipt number, transaction ID, date, amount, and status.
2: Records must be non-editable.
3: System must store and display all previous payments.
4: Downloads of receipts must be available.

column2:
User Story 1 (25676)

Story ID: US_ALG_001
Title: Access View Logs Section
As an architect or chief architect,
I want to access the “View Logs”  of Empanelment Process,
So that I can see all activities performed in my workflow.
column4:
1“View Logs” tab should be available while clicking on the Manage Application and Payment menu.
2 Upon clicking, the system should fetch all relevant activity records.
3 Data should display in a structured table format.
4 Each record should include the date, activity name, and activity status.

column2:
User Story 2 (25677)

Story ID: US_ALG_002
Title: Display All Activity Details
As an architect or chief architect,
I want to see details of each activity (date, name, and status),
So that I can monitor the progress and actions taken on my applications.
column4:
1 Each log must display:

2 Date/Time of the activity
Activity Name (e.g., Application Submission, Payment Done, Approved, etc.)
Status (Completed, Reverted, Pending, etc.)
Logs should appear in chronological order.

3 The system should automatically update logs when new actions occur.

column2:
User Story 3 (25678)

Story ID: US_ALG_003
Title: Filter or Sort Logs (Optional Feature)
As an architect or chief architect,
I want to filter or sort activity logs by date, status, or activity type,
So that I can easily locate specific activities in the log list.
column4:
1 Filters should include date range, status, and activity name.
2 Sorting should be possible in ascending or descending order by date.
3 Filtered results should update instantly on-screen.
4 If no results are found, the message “No matching logs found” should appear.

column2:
User Story 4 (25679)

Story ID: US_ALG_004
Title: Handle Empty or Error Scenarios
As an architect or chief architect,
I want the system to display proper messages when no logs are available or when an error occurs,
So that I clearly understand the system’s response.
column4:
1 If no logs are found, show: “No activity logs available.”
2 If a system error occurs, show: “Unable to load logs. Please try again later.”
3 Log data must never be partially displayed or corrupted.
4 Page must remain stable and navigable even during load failure.

column2:
US ID:  ARSEC-001 (28079)
AS-W-1 Land Case Intake Forwarding (Div EE ? CA)

Story Point: 1



As a Division Executive Engineer (Div EE), I want to forward a Land ID to the Chief Architect with all required land documents and metadata, so that the architectural workflow can be initiated with complete inputs.
column4:
Verify-
1 Div EE must be able to select a Land ID and choose Forward to Chief Architect.

2 Div EE must be able to attach/upload documents: Circle, Division, Khasra Map, DTS Survey, Patwari Report, Location Survey, AutoCAD file, Covering Letter, Development Plan (Land Use)

3 System must capture sender user, timestamp, and forwarding remarks

4 Land ID status must change to Intake Submitted (or equivalent “Submitted to CA”)

5 Land ID must appear on CA dashboard in the relevant queue

6 Audit Log must capture document attachments and the forward action
column9: Notesheet is static doc

column2:
Story ID: ARSEC-002 (28080)
AS-W-2 Case Assignment & Execution Mode Selection (CA)

Story Point: 3

As a Chief Architect, I want to assign a submitted Land ID to an Architect/Assistant Architect and select execution mode (In-House or Competition), so that the correct execution workflow is triggered and ownership is established.
column4:
Verify-
1 CA must be able to open any Land ID with status Intake Submitted and select Assign & Select Mode
